name: Band Standing Hip Abduction
steps: Stand tall with a resistance band looped around both ankles, holding a sturdy wall or chair for balance.
Keep your supporting leg slightly bent at the knee and your torso upright.
Slowly lift your target leg straight out to the side against the resistance of the band, keeping your toes pointing forward.
Lift outward approximately 30 to 45 degrees until you feel a firm contraction in your outer hip and glute.
Hold for 1 to 2 seconds at the peak abduction.
Slowly lower your foot back toward the center without letting your feet touch.
coaching_cues: Do not lean your torso sideways to swing the leg; keep your upper body perfectly vertical.
Keep your toes pointing straight forward, not rotated upward toward the ceiling.
Squeeze the outer glute muscle on both the moving and stabilizing hips.

sources.attribution: AAOS Hip Conditioning & Gait Stability Protocol
